tools.name: search_geographies
tools.description:
Find geographies by name, e.g. 'Essex County', 'Newark ward 5', 'Toronto Centre'.

    country: 'US' or 'CA'. level: one of the levels from coverage_summary (e.g. 'county', 'precinct',
    'congressional_district', 'federal_electoral_district'). region: USPS state or province code ('NJ', 'ON').

tools.name: get_geography
tools.description:
Full record for one geography: attributes, parent chain up to the country, child counts by level,
    and the source it came from (licence, vintage, last fetched).

tools.name: related_geographies
tools.description:
Links between geographies that overlap without nesting, with population shares.

    Districts: for a precinct, county, town, city (place) or ZIP, the congressional, state senate and state house
    districts it falls in; for a district, the precincts, counties, towns, cities or ZIPs inside it (filt

tools.name: list_children
tools.description:
Geographies directly under `id` (state -> counties and districts, county -> precincts and towns,
    province -> ridings). Filter with `level`; page with limit/offset (max 1000).

tools.name: list_geographies
tools.description:
Every geography at one level, optionally within one state/province, e.g. all congressional districts
    in 'NJ' or all federal ridings in 'ON'. Page with limit/offset (max 1000).

tools.name: nearest_geographies
tools.description:
Geographies at `level` whose internal point is closest to (lat, lon). This is a nearest-point
    approximation, not point-in-polygon. To find the geography containing a point, use locate_point.

tools.name: data_freshness
tools.description:
When each upstream dataset was last fetched and checked, what period it describes (vintage),
    how often it is re-checked, and whether it is overdue. Includes the recent refresh history.

tools.name: coverage_summary
tools.description: What's in the atlas: row counts by country and level, with the vintage of each layer.

tools.name: get_boundaries
tools.description:
Polygon boundaries as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection (EPSG:4326, RFC 7946 winding), for drawing dashboard maps.

    id: the geography to draw, e.g. 'us:county:34013'. children_level: draw everything at that level inside it
